title: A picked measurement's numbers stay readable, clear of the turn knob and on the canvas
goal: Picking a size measurement puts the turn knob and its arrows on top of its numbers, covering what the person picked it to read, and a measurement close to the bottom of a screenshot puts its width number below the canvas where nobody can see it. A measurement's numbers should stay in view and clear of every handle.
